description: This is the main activity class for an Android application that implements video recording functionality using the device's camera and MediaRecorder API. It manages camera preview, media recorder setup, recording control, and handles lifecycle events related to media resources.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Primary activity managing camera and media recorder for video capture.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and references UI components.

methods.name: onCaptureClick
methods.description: Handles start and stop of video recording based on user interaction.

methods.name: setCaptureButtonText
methods.description: Updates the text of the capture button.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Releases media resources when the activity is paused.

methods.name: releaseMediaRecorder
methods.description: Releases the MediaRecorder object and resets its configuration.

methods.name: prepareVideoRecorder
methods.description: Configures camera and MediaRecorder for video recording, setting sources, profiles, and output file.

methods.name: MediaPrepareTask
methods.description: An AsyncTask subclass that performs preparation of MediaRecorder in background.
